prompt: qual é o status do catálogo? apenas confira e responda
expected_behavior: Classify as trivial read-only or quick command, use compact proof, and do not invoke Wave-Gated Execution.

prompt: corrija este bug pequeno e prove com teste focado
expected_behavior: Classify as bounded slice or trivial mutation depending on scope; use entry/proof/closure, not wave-gated unless a repeated denominator appears.

prompt: implemente uma feature grande ponta-a-ponta uma vez e valide
expected_behavior: Classify as orchestrated mission one-shot with ledger/proof lanes; do not use coverage wave gates unless repeatable target sets are identified.

prompt: padronize todos os endpoints em ondas, teste tudo e avance só com cobertura maior que 95%
expected_behavior: Use orchestrated mission / wave-gated mode; freeze denominator, emit Wave Packet, compute Coverage Gate, run correction/reproof loop, then Wave Closure Packet.

prompt: faça três ajustes pequenos independentes e me diga o que mudou
expected_behavior: Use bounded slice with checklist and requested-vs-delivered proof; do not use wave-gated unless tasks are homogeneous/repeated.

prompt: audite backend, frontend, docs e integrações, corrija tudo e prove
expected_behavior: Use orchestrated mission; split lanes first, then apply wave-gated execution only to repeated target sets within lanes.

prompt: explique conceitualmente o que é cobertura de testes sem executar nada
expected_behavior: Do not run accelerate mutation workflow; answer conversationally unless the user asks for operational execution.

prompt: use Accelerate com Fable Method para executar esta mudança e fechar com prova outcome-first
expected_behavior: Keep one Accelerate root, set fable_overlay=required, apply the bounded Fable loop inside the active branch, and do not create duplicate packets, ledgers, proof lanes or closure.

prompt: use apenas o Fable Method para reescrever este relatório outcome-first, sem orquestração
expected_behavior: Do not activate Accelerate solely because Fable is named when no engineering/root-governance trigger exists.

prompt: use Accelerate para corrigir uma chave YAML local bem definida e validar o parser
expected_behavior: Use a bounded Accelerate branch, set fable_overlay=not-needed, and rely on the specialist/parser proof without loading Fable automatically.

prompt: use Accelerate: a especificação diz desconto de 10%, o teste exige 15% e o código implementa 10%; resolva e prove
expected_behavior: Set fable_overlay=useful, resolve intent from primary authority before editing, correct the wrong side through the specialist lane, and close only through Accelerate root proof.
